purpose: Activation test prompts. Use them to check that the description triggers on requests to rewrite a transcript, recording, essay, or chat into a complete, impersonal, structured document without filler, and stays silent on one-line summaries, translation, style editing that keeps the author's voice, transcription itself, and code work that belongs to the other skills in this collection. Run each prompt in a fresh agent session with the skill installed and record whether the skill was loaded.
should_trigger: Here's the transcript of a training video, transcripts/onboarding-03.txt. Strip the fluff and turn it into a proper step-by-step guide, no names, keep all the details.
Turn the recording of yesterday's Zoom call (call-2026-11-03.txt) into minutes I can send around: decisions, who does what, deadlines.
I exported our Telegram chat with the contractor to chat.txt. Pull out what we actually agreed on, what it costs, and what's still open.
This lecture transcript is 40 pages of rambling. Rewrite it as clean structured notes without losing any of the facts.
Clean up this essay into a tight thesis outline: main idea, arguments, conclusion. No fluff, but don't drop any arguments.
We interviewed three customers; the transcripts are in interviews/. Make an anonymized summary by topic for the product team.
Anonymize this support chat log and rewrite it as a knowledge base article: what the problem was and how it was solved.
Убери воду из этой расшифровки и сделай обезличенную инструкцию, максимально содержательную и последовательную.
Вот выгрузка переписки из рабочего чата, вытащи суть: о чём договорились, какие задачи и сроки.
Сделай протокол по записи созвона, файл meeting.srt лежит в папке records.
should_not_trigger: Summarize this article in one sentence.
Edit my essay for grammar and flow, but keep my voice and style.
Transcribe these MP4 files to text with Whisper.
Generate SRT subtitles for this video.
Write a README for this repository.
Audit this codebase and give me a prioritized list of problems to fix.
Refactor the chat-export parser into separate modules without changing its behavior.
Draw a cover image for my meeting notes.
